tips.text: This project is NOT Mathlib4. Lemma names differ. Always use lean_local_search before guessing.
Proofs >30 lines must be decomposed into helper lemmas (each ≤15 lines). Write them BEFORE the main theorem.
lean_diagnostic_messages with timeout_s=30 after EVERY edit. partial:true means still elaborating — poll again.
Max 1-3 lines per edit. Check errors after each edit. If errors increase, revert immediately.
Tactic order: rfl → simp → norm_num → linarith → nlinarith → omega → exact → apply → rw → have → calc
LebesgueOuterMeasure.of_Icc a b gives measure of preimage of [a,b] as b-a. Use Real.equiv_EuclideanSpace' to embed ℝ.
BoundedInterval with IsClosed.toSet is Icc a b or empty, by closed_eq_Icc_or_empty.
LebesgueMeasure.countable_union gives m(⋃ E_n) = ∑' m(E_n) for measurable disjoint E_n.

errors.solution: --solution Add condition that sets are subsets of R (no infinite values), or that 0 in A whenever sInf A = 0 and infinity in B.
